home.title: Find work that fits your skills
home.subtitle: Sign in to see jobs and courses matched to what you can do.
home.organisationNote: This app is for job seekers. To post vacancies or courses, sign in on the website.

signIn.consentAgree: I have read the privacy notice and agree to the terms of use.
signIn.needConsent: There is no account for this number yet. Tick the box to agree to the privacy notice, then ask for a new code: that one has been used.

update.title: Please update the app
update.body: This version of the app is no longer supported. Update it from the store to continue.

list.loadMoreFailed: Could not load more. Your list is still here.

detail.signInToMatch: Sign in to see how well you match this.
detail.otherwise: Not what you were looking for?

me.title: Me
me.signInPrompt: Sign in to see your matches, applications and profile.
me.menu: What would you like to do?
me.updatesCount: {count, plural, one {# new update} other {# new updates}}

push.title: Get updates on your phone
push.body: We can send a notification when an employer replies or a vacancy you applied for closes. It never shows your name, your phone number or what an employer wrote: it only says there is something to read here.

invite.title: This invitation is for an organisation
invite.body: This app is for job seekers. To join an organisation, open the invitation in your phone's browser and sign in there.

account.shareFailed: Could not open the share sheet. Try again.
account.signedOut: Sign in to see your account.

contact.signedOutNote: Sign in to send a request about your own data, or to see what you sent before.
contact.intro: Ask a question or send us a note. For a complaint about how your data is handled, or about something on the marketplace, choose “A complaint” below: it carries a deadline we are held to.

misconfigured.title: This copy of the app is not set up correctly
misconfigured.body: It cannot reach our service safely, so it has not started. Please install the app again from the store. If this keeps happening, tell us at the website.
